mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within two months signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations adjust downwards.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over three consecutive months signals disinflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real income and purchasing power increase.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 5% each in a month signals a broad-based weakening of demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth prospects dim.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2%) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as liquidity flows into equities.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
